exposure: Maternal tetanus toxoid (MTT) vaccination status (single dose, adequate doses, no doses)
Mode of delivery (cesarean section or not)
cohort: The study utilized data from 23,402 cases from the 2019 Bangladesh Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey (MICS), representing mothers and their infants in Bangladesh.
finding: Children whose mothers did not receive tetanus toxoid vaccination during pregnancy had a 36% higher risk of neonatal mortality, while administering a minimum of one dose, and especially adequate doses, significantly lowered this risk.
cross-section timing: Data from the 2019 Bangladesh Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey (MICS)
